outcome: postoperative interventions (transfusion, imaging, reoperation, repeat lab draw, readmission)
cohort: Patients who underwent laparoscopic, robotic-assisted, abdominal, or vaginal hysterectomy or myomectomy at a single tertiary referral center between January 2014 and January 2019.
finding: Routine postoperative hemoglobin testing after benign gynecological surgery showed limited utility, as a significant decrease in hemoglobin did not lead to additional interventions other than increased lab draws.
